title: The post composer offers the Journeys a member follows, not only their Practices

source.ref: Feature-path wiring scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end)

detail:
The composer's Share kind (LIVE-682) lists a member's Practices and Journeys. The Journeys half read journey_enrollments through the session client, but journey_enrollments has RLS on and no policies (deny-all, service-only, checked in Frequency Community 2026-11-18: 5 rows, 0 policies), so the read always came back empty and no member could ever share a Journey. Fix: listShareables hands shareables the service reader, and the read stays pinned to the caller's own profileId (feed-list.tsx already reads the same table this way).

DONE 2026-11-18: the Journeys read goes through the service reader scoped to the caller; Practices stay on the session client.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
